title: Derive balanced CRT node selection and precision from the physical source before invoking the numerical producer (no new kappa)
body:
## Exact result and novelty
A tape-driven frontend derives every balanced CRT node, width and precision from the physical axis stream, invoking unchanged #5219/#5053 numerical code on the #5505 bank. It uses 78 stable owned roles with linear-use result leases, O(p^4) source operations and O(p^2) owned backing plus the supplied source history. Its raw frontend actions have bound 2^16(M+2)^2; complete control retains an unspecified fixed constant.

## Reproduction and independent checks
Four physical fixtures execute 14 actual numerical nodes; an independent 63-node/78-role review and negative controls passed. Replay: python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/encoded-balanced-crt-entry

## Limitations and bound status
No new kappa. Row/ROM selection, source updates, three-epoch transport, binary lowering, and whole-iterator restart remain open. Selected conditional kappa remains 0.00363005817; the five framework assumptions remain.

## Attribution
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit #5353, #5219, #5053, #5505 and earlier CRT construction.
